summary: BrenX Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing a $1,000,000 subsequent funding under its July 25, 2025 securities purchase agreement with Alpha Capital Anstalt. The company will issue 1,000 preferred shares at a $1,000 stated value, convertible at $2.616 per ordinary share, plus ordinary warrants for 382,263 shares at $87.36, expiring five years from issuance. Closing is expected on or about September 17, 2026. The pricing triggered an anti-dilution ratchet resetting prior preferred conversion terms; proceeds fund general corporate purposes and TES projects.
